svg.title: uššira piṭāti
svg.desc: The Aten disc of the Amarna period, its rays reaching outward — the one iconography belonging to this reign and no other. Read as a graph the same figure is a star: a hub joined to every correspondent and no edge between any two of them, which is what the Amarna correspondence network turns out to be — zero triangles. The rays end in the correspondents rather than in the Aten's hands. A design motif, not a drawing of any particular relief.
